label: CCRL Rating
description: Ratings from the Computer Chess Rating Lists (CCRL) for the engines in engines.json, used with the permission of the CCRL team. Show them labelled "CCRL Rating", with a link to https://computerchess.org.uk/ccrl/.

40/15.name: CCRL 40/15
40/15.selection: Open source single-CPU engines, best versions only

blitz.name: CCRL Blitz
blitz.selection: Open source single-CPU engines, best versions only

metadata_notes.selection: Every rating comes from the list of open-source engines on one CPU, best version of each engine only, so ratings from the same list compare with each other.
metadata_notes.matching: A CCRL row belongs to the engine whose name, id or alias equals the longest run of its leading words, ignoring case and punctuation. An engine's ccrl_name in engines.json, when present, is used instead; null means the engine has no CCRL rating.
metadata_notes.ratings: Per list: the rating, the larger of its two error margins, the rank within the selection, games played, the version CCRL rated, and its CCRL details page.
